t: A microcontroller with built-in analog parts and logic you can rewire.
steps: Buy the CY8CKIT-059 prototyping kit from DigiKey for about 24 US dollars.
Install PSoC Creator and PSoC Programmer from Infineon on a Windows computer.
Plug the kit's KitProg end into a USB port.
Open the kit guide and load the blinking LED example project.
Build the project and program the board from PSoC Creator.
Add a component such as a PWM block and watch the LED fade.
Try an ADC example with a potentiometer on a breadboard.
meta: Open Board. From $23.55. A few stores.
